caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a weathered appearance, shown in a three-quarter view facing to the left. The chair is constructed of several wooden planks, with three vertical slats forming the backrest; the outer two are irregularly shaped and the inner one is straight. The top of the backrest features a pentagonal arrangement of wooden pieces. The seat is made from flat wooden slats set side by side, with the edges appearing worn. The legs are formed from crossed wooden boards, creating an X shape on each side for stability. The color palette is predominantly natural wood tones, ranging from light brown to darker, aged hues, with visible grain and texture lines. The background of the drawing is plain and uncolored, accentuating the chair as the sole subject of the composition. The artist's signature, "ROSE CAMPBELL GERKE," appears in small text in the lower left portion of the drawing.
title: Miner's Chair - Hand Made
